title: Terms of service
intro: What we do, what no consultancy can promise, and what we expect from you.

children.text: Advisory and application support for students seeking admission to universities in Türkiye, along with the courses and business services described elsewhere on this site. We are a consultancy. We are not a university, we do not make admission decisions, and we do not issue visas.
We cannot guarantee admission, a scholarship, or a visa. Those decisions belong to universities, scholarship bodies and the Turkish authorities.
Anyone who guarantees those outcomes is describing something they do not control. Treat such a guarantee as a warning sign, from us or from anybody else.
Costs shown on this site are indicative bands carrying the date they were last reviewed. They are not quotations.
Our fee is confirmed in writing at your first consultation and before any payment is taken. What it covers and what it excludes is set out at the same time.
University, authentication, translation, visa and insurance charges are separate and payable by you. We do not add a margin to them.

You may end the engagement at any time in writing. Money already paid to a university, an authority or a translator cannot be recovered, because we no longer hold it. How our own fee is treated is set out in the agreement you sign at the start.
The information and documents you give us must be accurate and genuine. A fabricated or altered document ends the engagement immediately and without refund.
You are also responsible for meeting the deadlines we give you. Authentication and denklik run on queues we do not control, and a late start is the most common reason a student misses an intake.
Pages carry the date they were last reviewed. Requirements change, so confirm anything decision-critical with us directly before acting on it.
Set out in the written agreement you sign, rather than left to be inferred from a website footer.
